response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack development experience and a passion for open-source geospatial projects, but his recent work lacks deep focus on C++/Rust or large-scale routing/tiling systems. His GISCollective project and FOSS4G talk show relevant geospatial expertise, though the role's emphasis on C++ and distributed systems may require closer evaluation.
strengths: Extensive geospatial experience through GISCollective and FOSS4G contributions, aligning with routing/tiling domain.
Proven track record in building scalable systems (e.g., Optilyz, Sociomantic) with performance optimization skills.
Strong open-source contributions and knowledge-sharing (workshops, talks) indicating collaborative problem-solving.
concerns: Primary expertise in TypeScript/Node.js with limited recent C++/Rust experience (last noted in 2015-2018).
No explicit experience with routing data pipelines or real-time traffic integration in commercial settings.
Diverse project history may dilute specialization in the role's core technical requirements.
